AOPA FOUNDATION  
AVIATION SCHOLARSHIP PROGRAM  
 
FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS 
Spring Application Period: April 1 – June 30, 11:59 p.m. ET | All applicants will receive a 
decision email by September 15. 
Fall Application Period: October 1 – December 31, 11:59 p.m. ET | All applicants will receive a 
decision email by April 15. 
 
ELIGIBILITY 
Open to current AOPA members who are residents of the United States and District of Columbia, Canada, 
Guam, Puerto Rico, and the U.S. Virgin Islands. Some scholarships have additional eligibility requirements. 
GETTING STARTED 
Do I need to be an AOPA member to apply?  
Yes. You must be a current AOPA member to apply. Click here to learn about our complimentary high school 
membership or explore other membership options here.  
When can I apply? 
Applications are open from April 1 through June 30, at 11:59 p.m. ET and October 1 through December 31, 
11:59 p.m. ET. 
Important: If you applied in previous cycles, you must submit a new application or resubmit your previous 
application each cycle and maintain current AOPA membership. 
How do I apply? 
1. Visit the application portal and click “Sign In” in the upper right corner 
2. If you don’t have an account, create a username and password (your AOPA credentials will not 
work on the application site). 
3. Use an updated browser (Google Chrome, Mozilla Firefox, or Safari) for best results 
4. Complete the General Application 
5. The system will automatically match you to eligible scholarships based on your responses 
Deadline reminder: Submit ALL supporting documents, including references, by June 30, 11:59 p.m. 
ET (spring application period) or December 31, 11:59 p.m. ET (fall application period).

2 
 
APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS 
What must applicants submit? 
1. Completed online application with written responses 
2. Two references (see Recommendation Process for details) 
3. High School Students Only: Recent transcript that includes the most recent school year grades  
a. Please submit a transcript downloaded from your school’s student portal or website, listing the 
following:  
• All courses taken during high school 
• Grades earned in each course 
• Your current school year grades 
• Your cumulative unweighted GPA calculated on a 4.0 scale 
• School name 
Format: Do not mail transcripts. Upload them with your application.  
Date requirements: Transcripts must be dated within the current school year. 
9th-grade students: You may include middle school grades if needed.  
RECOMMENDATION PROCESS 
How does the recommendation process work? 
• Download the reference form from your application 
• Send it to your references 
• References complete the form (typed preferred, handwritten accepted) 
• References return the form to you 
• You upload the forms to your application in the online portal 
Important: References must use the provided form. No email submissions or alternative formats will be 
accepted. Your references must complete the form, and you must upload the completed form to your 
application by the scholarship application period deadline. 
High school students: 
• At least one reference must be from a teacher, counselor, coach, or school official  
• Your second reference can be from another teacher, school official, flight instructor, or any supervising 
adult 
Examples of acceptable references: 
o Teachers or guidance counselors 
o Coaches or school officials 
o Flight instructors 
o Work supervisors 
o After-school program leaders

3 
 
o Civil Air Patrol leaders 
o Youth pastors or church leaders 
Who CANNOT be my reference? 
Your application will be disqualified if you use: 
o Parents or guardians 
o Other relatives 
o Friends your same age 
 Homeschool: If your parent is your teacher, you must find alternative references such as employers, 
activity leaders, or coaches. 
 What should my references write about? 
 Strong references explain: 
o How they know you and their relationship to you 
o Examples of your responsibility and leadership 
o Your decision-making skills 
o Your interest in aviation 
o Why you deserve this scholarship 
ELIGIBILITY QUESTIONS 
Can I apply if I've already started flight training? 
Yes, as long as you haven't completed your checkride. If you pass your checkride before the scholarship award 
date, you will no longer be eligible. 
Do I need to be in a college aviation program? 
Generally, no; however, some scholarships are only available to those attending an accredited college or 
university. Please visit aopa.org/scholarships to view the additional criteria for select scholarships.   
TEACHER SCHOLARSHIPS 
What are the additional requirements for teachers applying for the AOPA Foundation Teacher Flight 
Training Scholarship? 
Teachers must meet these requirements to be eligible: 
• Current, paid, full-time employee of a school or school system during 2025-2026 
• Currently utilizing the AOPA Foundation High School Aviation STEM Curriculum 
• Provide a verification letter from your school district signed by a district administrator 
 
Can teachers use these scholarships for advanced ratings? 
No. The AOPA Foundation Teacher Flight Training Scholarships are specifically for achieving a primary pilot 
certificate; however, we do have additional scholarships available for those pursuing advanced ratings. 
Can I apply as a teacher who wants to learn to fly for personal reasons?

4 
 
You must meet the requirements listed above to be eligible for the AOPA Foundation Teacher Flight Training 
Scholarships; however, additional scholarships are available through the AOPA Foundation for teachers who 
wish to pursue a private pilot certificate or advanced training.  
AWARD INFORMATION 
How will I know if I've been selected? 
Award notifications are sent via email to the address listed on your application. Check your email regularly! 
How do I receive scholarship funds? 
Funds are provided directly to recipients via a prepaid expense card, not sent to flight schools. 
How long do I have to use the scholarship? 
Scholarship funds will expire after 12 months for flight training scholarships and after 24 months for aviation 
maintenance scholarships.  
What if I didn’t get selected in the spring / fall application period? 
You're welcome to resubmit your application for the next scholarship application period. 
APPLICATION RULES & DEADLINES 
Can I submit a paper application? 
No. All applications must be submitted online through the portal. 
Are there exceptions for late submissions? 
No exceptions will be made for late submissions. Applications and all recommendations must be submitted by 
June 30, 11:59 p.m. ET (spring application period) or December 31, 11:59 p.m. ET (fall application period). Allow 
your references ample time to complete their forms. 
 
 
REMINDER! 
BE SURE TO REVIEW THE FAQS BEFORE EMAILING AOPA WITH QUESTIONS. 
If we have not answered your questions here, please email [public support email omitted].
